item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Group names by rationale, not just wording","mechanism":"Separate underlying directions from wording variants so similar names can represent different intentions without erasing their origins.","implementation":"Add rationale and addressed-constraint fields. Allow suggestions in multiple labeled direction groups; retain immutable originals and privately recorded authorship through merges.","check":"Submit two similar names with different rationales. Verify both directions remain visible and each original is recoverable after grouping.","risk":"Overlapping groups may require manual clarification."},{"action":"Make rejections depend on versioned constraints","mechanism":"A rejection references the constraint version that justified it, allowing changed requirements to reopen the discussion.","implementation":"Require a rejection explanation and linked constraint or explicit other reason. When a linked constraint changes, mark the rejection for reconsideration without deleting history.","check":"Reject a name for exceeding three words; raise the limit. Verify its rejection is flagged for review, not silently reversed.","risk":"Frequent edits could produce excessive reconsideration notices."},{"action":"Give late suggestions an anonymous first review","mechanism":"A separate review queue prevents arrival time, visible endorsements, and author identity from substituting for assessment.","implementation":"Show every unreviewed suggestion without authorship or endorsement counts. Use an explicitly disclosed shuffled order; restrict private authorship records to authorized access.","check":"Add a late alternative after endorsements accumulate. Verify it enters anonymous review and ordinary reviewers cannot retrieve its author through the API.","risk":"Distinctive wording may still reveal an author."},{"action":"Keep hard-constraint conflicts visible despite popularity","mechanism":"A constraint assessment remains independent of endorsements, making a popular but unsuitable name visibly unresolved rather than automatically rejected.","implementation":"Let users mark constraints as hard and record pass, conflict, or unknown with evidence. Display conflicts on cards without ranking or selecting names.","check":"Give a hard-constraint-violating name the most endorsements. Verify its conflict stays visible and no winner is declared.","risk":"Disputed assessments need explicit resolution rather than authoritative badges."},{"action":"Require evidence for “already considered” dismissals","mechanism":"A duplicate claim must address the new rationale, not merely point to a similar earlier name.","implementation":"Replace one-click duplicate dismissal with a linked prior suggestion and an explanation covering the new rationale. Preserve both submissions; allow authors to contest equivalence.","check":"Submit two similar names solving different constraints. Verify a duplicate claim displays both rationales and can be disputed without restoring deleted content.","risk":"Additional review work may slow genuinely repetitive submissions."},{"action":"Expose unexplored directions in a constraint map","mechanism":"A direction-by-constraint view reveals gaps and competing approaches without turning attention or endorsements into ordering signals.","implementation":"Add a matrix with direction rows, constraint columns, and linked evidence for addressed, conflicted, or unknown cells. Use alphabetical ordering and no aggregate score.","check":"Create several wording variants in one direction and one distinct alternative. Verify both directions appear and variants do not multiply coverage.","risk":"A dense matrix may need accessible filtering and summaries."},{"action":"Carry unresolved dissent into decision summaries","mechanism":"Persistent dissent records prevent a human-made shortlist from being mistaken for unanimous agreement or comprehensive consideration.","implementation":"Let participants attach an unresolved objection and alternative to a shortlist. Include these records in exports; retain them until explicitly resolved with an explanation.","check":"Shortlist a popular name while another direction has an unresolved objection. Verify the summary and export retain that objection and linked alternative.","risk":"Unresolved objections must not become an indefinite veto."}],"abstention_reason":""}
